releaseNotes: Fixes iOS topic-list scroll restoration: removes the legacy Exam Planner page-only scroll memo that reset the real app scroller to the top, while keeping the navigation history stack. The shared route-aware scroll layer now restores the exact previous topic-list position.

Synchronizes the Clinical Case bank with To Me: 481 shared cases and 1,840 questions, preserving case and question IDs while aligning vignettes, stems, options, correct-answer text, explanations and validation metadata.
Adds the direction-aware sticky Back control and route-aware scroll restoration from To Me, returning to the exact previous bank, system or topic-list position without resetting student progress.

Restores the original layout of the final two onboarding screens: the wider grade-selection panel, full-width overflow, final artwork proportions, welcome spacing, and hidden description and grade badge.

Restores the full-screen Setup experience for the first offline installation only. The installer prepares its checklist and storage during the ECG splash, then the Setup screen appears immediately after the splash.

The first-install package is downloaded and verified before the onboarding scripts and question-bank data are loaded, preventing them from competing with the installer for network and startup resources.

After the first install, the app opens from its saved local package. Repairs and updates stay in the background with a compact progress chip; automatic update checks run every 48 hours and Settings can trigger a manual check.
Keeps the To Me verified updater with resumable downloads, per-file size and SHA-256 validation, staged updates, and one safe restart after verified changes are committed.
Preserves the existing iOS cache namespace shbace-medical-offline-v2, IndexedDB database shbace-medical-offline-state-v1, student data, iOS icon, and onboarding screens.
